notes: 植物基因组学领域种子期刊。acceptance_rate 无公开权威数据一律为 null（不编造）；impact_factor / review_time_weeks 为公开 JCR/期刊官网常识近似值，以 last_updated 标注刷新时间，接入真实数据源前需人工核验。scope_desc 为英文范围描述，供 vstore 向量匹配使用。 format_rules_default 为通用默认规则（rules_source=default）；精选 5 本 format_rules 已于 2026-10-10 按各刊官网投稿指南人工核验填入（rules_source=official，附 source_url / last_verified / notes），官网未规定的字段一律 null 不猜测。 新增标签字段（不进 SQLite，接口按 id 从本文件合并）：scope_tags / application_tags / cross_domain 按 scope_desc 归类的标签；cas_partition / jcr_quartile 为占位（partition_source=placeholder），核实不确定的一律 null、不猜测，接入真实分区数据前需人工核验。 精选列表已更换为本环境可访问官网的 5 本（Genome Biology / BMC Plant Biology / Molecular Plant / Frontiers in Plant Science / Rice）；原 OUP/Wiley/Springer 4 本（The Plant Cell / The Plant Journal / Theoretical and Applied Genetics / The Plant Genome）移出精选，仍保留在 journal_directory 1056 条全量目录中。 [2026-10-12] 5 本精选期刊新增 review_tier（1=顶刊/2=主流，供 presubmit recommendation 分档判定；匹配失败默认 tier 2）。

journals.name: Genome Biology
journals.scope_desc: High-impact open-access journal for genome-scale research across all organisms, including genome assembly and annotation, comparative and evolutionary genomics, computational methods, single-cell and multi-omics studies, and reproducible bioinformatics.

format_rules.notes: 官网要求双倍行距（'Use double-line spacing'）、行页码编号；参考文献 'Journal abbreviations follow Index Medicus/MEDLINE'（顺序编号制→vancouver）；BMC 出版社 policy 页明确 single-anonymous（审稿人知道作者身份，作者无需匿名）；字号/边距/页数上限该页未规定。BMC editorial policy 辅助来源：https://www.biomedcentral.com/getpublished/editorial-policies

journals.name: BMC Plant Biology
journals.scope_desc: Open-access journal covering all aspects of plant biology, from molecular and cellular studies to the physiology and ecology of whole plants and communities, including plant-microbe interactions, biotechnology and applied plant science.

format_rules.notes: 同 BMC 系列模板页：双倍行距+行页码编号；参考文献 MEDLINE 缩写（→vancouver）；BMC 系列 editorial policy 为 single-anonymous（作者无需匿名）；字号/边距/页数上限该页未规定。

journals.name: Molecular Plant
journals.scope_desc: High-impact journal for fundamental and translational plant science at the molecular level, covering genomics, cell and developmental biology, signal transduction, stress and metabolic responses, and plant biotechnology.

format_rules.notes: 官网作者指南（本环境 cell.com 403，依据作者浏览器核对摘录）：正文 12 point 字号、1.5 行距，参考文献 'cited in the text by name and year in parentheses'（作者-年份制→author_year）；页数上限/边距/图表下限/匿名审稿政策该摘录未覆盖→null

journals.name: Frontiers in Plant Science
journals.scope_desc: Open-access journal spanning fundamental and applied plant sciences: molecular and cellular mechanisms, physiology, ecology, evolution, and applications in agriculture and biotechnology.

format_rules.notes: 官网 author-guidelines：'The entire document should be single-spaced and must contain page and line numbers'（单倍行距→1.0）；页数按 Article types 页 word count 而非数字页限→max_pages=null；字号/边距/图表下限该页未规定。Frontiers 为 open peer review；官网未明文规定作者是否匿名，建议人工核实 review-guidelines 页。Frontiers 官网明确两种制式并存：Harvard (author-date) 或 Vancouver (numbered)，具体到 Plant Science 需查 help center（当前抓取失败），建议人工核实 https://www.frontiersin.org/help/

journals.name: Rice
journals.scope_desc: Open-access journal publishing research on all aspects of rice science, from molecular biology and genetics to breeding, physiology, ecology and production systems, with relevance to cereal crop improvement.

format_rules.notes: SpringerOpen 系列模板页：'Use double-line spacing'（双倍行距→2.0）、行页码编号；参考文献 'Journal abbreviations follow Index Medicus/MEDLINE'（→vancouver）；审稿明文 single-anonymous（审稿人知道作者身份，作者无需匿名）；字号/边距/页数上限/图表下限该页未规定。
